lessons.title: Welcome — Understanding Images
lessons.content:
Welcome back.

Today, we will be exploring another important aspect of graphic design: working with images.

Images are a major part of visual communication. Whether you are designing posters, advertisements, social media graphics, flyers, or other visual materials, the images you choose and how you prepare them can significantly influence the quality of your final design.

However, working with images involves more than simply downloading a photograph and placing it on your canvas. You need to understand image quality, resolution, aspect ratios, cropping, composition, and how to select images that complement the message of your design.

In today's lesson, you will explore the fundamentals of digital images and learn how different image characteristics affect the way they appear and function within a design.

You will also learn how to identify suitable images for different design purposes and understand the importance of preparing images before using them in your projects.

The goal is to help you develop a better understanding of images and how to work with them effectively as a graphic designer.

lessons.title: What You'll Learn Today
lessons.content:
TODAY, YOU WILL EXPLORE:

- Understanding Raster Images
- Image Resolution
- Aspect Ratios
- Image Quality
- Cropping
- Composition in Photography
- Choosing the Right Image
- Understanding Image Backgrounds
- Preparing Images for Design

lessons.title: Part 1 — Understanding Raster Images
lessons.content:
Before working extensively with photographs and other digital images, you need to understand how they are created and how they behave.

In this lesson, you will be introduced to raster images and learn about their basic structure and characteristics.

You will begin to understand how raster images are made up of pixels and why their resolution can affect how clearly they appear, particularly when resized or used in different design environments.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

The explanation above is only a summary of the topic. Watch the full lesson below to develop a better understanding of raster images and their importance in graphic design.

lessons.title: Part 2 — Composition in Photography
lessons.content:
The quality of an image is not determined by its resolution alone. How the subject and other visual elements are arranged within a photograph also matters.

In this lesson, you will explore composition in photography and understand how the arrangement of subjects and elements within an image can influence its visual appeal and effectiveness.

You will begin to develop an eye for identifying photographs that have strong visual structure and can work well within your designs.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

This is only a brief introduction to photographic composition. Watch the full lesson below to understand the concepts being demonstrated and how they can influence the selection and use of images in graphic design.

WATCH THE LESSON HERE

Composition in Photography
https://youtu.be/8XBYt-_U4WE

lessons.title: Part 3 — Aspect Ratio and Cropping
lessons.content:
Images come in different shapes and dimensions, and understanding these differences is important when preparing photographs for design projects.

In this lesson, you will explore aspect ratios and cropping and understand how the dimensions and framing of an image can affect its appearance.

You will also learn why cropping is important when adjusting images to fit different design layouts and formats without unnecessarily compromising the subject or composition.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

The explanation above is only a summary. Watch the full lesson below to understand aspect ratios, cropping, and how they are applied when working with images.

WATCH THE LESSON HERE

Aspect Ratio and Cropping
https://youtu.be/_8vYe5Nrtdw

lessons.title: Part 4 — Choosing the Right Image & Understanding Image Backgrounds
lessons.content:
Not every attractive photograph is suitable for every design.

The images you select should complement the message, purpose, audience, and overall visual direction of your project.

In this lesson, you will explore how to choose appropriate images for different design purposes and understand the importance of image backgrounds.

You will begin to recognise how the subject, background, surrounding elements, and overall appearance of a photograph can influence how easily it fits into a design composition.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

This is only a brief introduction to image selection and image backgrounds. Watch the full lesson below to understand how to identify suitable images and the considerations involved in using them effectively.

WATCH THE LESSON HERE

Choosing the Right Image & Image Backgrounds
https://youtu.be/33zt2FpWNBA

lessons.title: Today's Goal
lessons.content:
Today's goal is to develop a better understanding of digital images and how to prepare and select them for graphic design projects.

By the end of today's lessons, you should have a clearer understanding of raster images, resolution, aspect ratios, image quality, cropping, photographic composition, and the importance of selecting appropriate images.

Remember, a good design does not depend only on how well you arrange your elements. The quality and suitability of the images you use also matter.

As you watch the lessons, pay attention to how images are structured, how they can be adjusted, and how the right image can contribute to the overall effectiveness of a design.

lessons.title: Tuesday — Photo Enhancement
lessons.content:
Welcome back.

In our previous lesson, you learned about digital images, image quality, resolution, cropping, photographic composition, and choosing the right images for your designs.

Today, we will build on that foundation by exploring photo enhancement.

As a graphic designer, you will frequently work with photographs that need adjustments before they can be used in your designs. Some images may appear too dark, too bright, dull, blurry, or have colours that do not complement the overall direction of your project.

Photo enhancement involves making adjustments to improve the appearance and quality of an image while ensuring that it remains suitable for its intended purpose.

In today's lesson, you will learn how to enhance photographs using the software available on your chosen design track.

If you are following the Smartphone Graphic Design Track, you will work with Lightroom Mobile. If you are following the PC Graphic Design Track, you will work with Adobe Photoshop.

The goal is to help you develop the ability to improve photographs and prepare them for use in professional design projects.

lessons.title: What You'll Learn Today — Photo Enhancement
lessons.content:
TODAY, YOU WILL EXPLORE:

- Understanding Photo Enhancement
- Image Exposure and Contrast
- Highlights, Shadows, Whites, and Blacks
- Temperature and Tint
- Vibrance and Saturation
- Clarity and Texture
- Sharpening and Noise Reduction
- Cropping and Colour Correction
- Basic Colour Grading
- Basic Image Correction

You will then apply these concepts using the software for your chosen track.

lessons.title: Part 1 — Smartphone Track: Photo Enhancement with Lightroom Mobile
lessons.content:
If you are following the Smartphone Graphic Design Track, this lesson introduces you to photo enhancement using Lightroom Mobile.

Lightroom provides tools that allow you to adjust different aspects of a photograph, including its lighting, contrast, colours, details, and overall appearance.

In this lesson, you will explore the different adjustment controls available in Lightroom and understand how they can be used to improve photographs.

You will also begin learning how to correct colours, refine image details, adjust brightness, and create more visually appealing photographs that are suitable for your design projects.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

The explanation above is only a summary of the topic. Watch the full lesson below and follow along on your smartphone to understand how the different adjustment tools work and how they can be applied when enhancing photographs.

WATCH THE LESSON HERE

Photo Enhancement with Lightroom Mobile
https://youtu.be/87TEUKmnmcg

lessons.title: Part 2 — PC Track: Photo Enhancement with Photoshop
lessons.content:
If you are following the PC Graphic Design Track, this lesson introduces you to photo enhancement and basic image correction using Adobe Photoshop.

Photoshop provides several tools for adjusting and improving photographs, allowing you to correct image appearance and prepare pictures for different design purposes.

In this lesson, you will explore how to crop and resize images, adjust brightness and contrast, work with colour adjustments, and improve image sharpness.

You will also become familiar with some of the adjustment tools available in Photoshop and understand how they can help you refine photographs before incorporating them into your designs.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

This is only a summary of the topic. Watch the full lesson below and follow along in Photoshop to become familiar with the image correction and enhancement techniques being demonstrated.

WATCH THE LESSON HERE

Photo Enhancement with Photoshop
https://youtu.be/zX3giJm216E

lessons.title: Today's Goal
lessons.content:
Today's goal is to move from simply selecting and understanding images to knowing how to improve them.

By the end of today's lessons, you should have a clearer understanding of photo enhancement and how to adjust lighting, contrast, colours, sharpness, and other image properties.

You should also become familiar with the photo enhancement tools available in Lightroom Mobile or Photoshop, depending on your chosen track.

Remember, a photograph does not always have to be perfect when you find it. What matters is understanding how to improve it and prepare it for the purpose of your design.

Take your time with the practical demonstrations and pay attention to how different adjustments affect the appearance of an image.
